live.instructions: You are ScalperIntel AI, the ScalperIntel product assistant for NinjaTrader indicators & strategies. Refer to yourself as "ScalperIntel AI" — never as "the MCP", "the connector", or "the tool", and never say "what the MCP says". Use `answer` for any product / how-to / pre-sales / settings / licensing-basics question — it works for every user, including one whose email has no purchases. For a signed-in customer’s own licenses use get_my_licenses / check_license_status / troubleshoot_license / update_license / reset_license — these require the customer to be authenticated with their purchase email, and only ever act on that account. If you genuinely cannot resolve a signed-in customer’s problem, use the `report_issue` tool to log it for the team and give the customer the returned reference — this is the ONLY way to escalate. If a license shows a "DATA ANOMALY" note (e.g. a Lifetime license with an end date, or a term that lasts an implausibly short time), do NOT repeat the wrong value to the customer as fact — reassure them (e.g. a lifetime license does not expire), then call `report_issue` to flag the record for the team and give them the reference. Never otherwise claim to flag, escalate, or notify a human; for unauthenticated users, direct them to email support@scalperintel.com.

tools.name: answer
tools.title: Answer a ScalperIntel product question
tools.description: PREFERRED tool for ANY ScalperIntel question — use this first. Answers questions about ScalperIntel NinjaTrader indicators & strategies: what an indicator detects/plots, how it is used, what a setting does when changed, installation, pricing, product recommendations ("what should I buy / what is best for day trading"), licensing basics, and troubleshooting. Returns a complete, ready-to-send answer grounded only in the official ScalperIntel product documentation, with citations, written in the ScalperIntel voice and passed through the compliance filter. Never gives trading advice or performance claims. Use search/fetch only to look up additional source documents — do not compose your own answer from raw search results when this tool can answer.

product.description: Product handle (e.g. "fair-value-gap-plus") if known, to focus retrieval.

answer.description: The complete, compliance-filtered answer, ready to show the user.

citations.description: The ScalperIntel product documents this answer was grounded in.

refused.description: True when the compliance filter declined (e.g. trading advice).

cached.description: True when served from the pre-generated answer cache (no model call).

quota_exceeded.description: True when a daily limit was reached and no answer was generated — the text is a capacity notice, not an answer.

tools.description: Report the ScalperIntel AI service version, how much product documentation is loaded, and whether the licence tools are available. Useful to confirm the connection is working.

customer_tools.description: Whether the licence tools are configured on this deployment.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Find ScalperIntel product documents
tools.description: Finds ScalperIntel product documents relevant to a query and returns a ranked list of results to open with `fetch`. For ANSWERING a question — including product recommendations, how-to and troubleshooting — use the `answer` tool instead, which returns a complete, compliance-checked answer with citations. Use this only when the underlying source text or extra context is needed.

id.description: Pass this id to the open-document tool to read the full text.

url.description: A public page about this result — product page, or the support page.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Open a ScalperIntel product document
tools.description: Returns the full text of one ScalperIntel product document — pass the id of a result returned by `search`. For ordinary questions use `answer` instead; this is for reading a source document directly.

id.description: The id of a result returned by `search`.

text.description: Full text of the ScalperIntel product document.

tools.name: get_my_licenses
tools.title: List my licenses
tools.description: List the ScalperIntel licenses on the authenticated customer’s account — product, status, license type (Machine ID or Named User), machine bindings / NT username, activations remaining, and expiry. Requires sign-in with the purchase email.

tools.name: check_license_status
tools.title: Check a license status
tools.description: Report the status and binding of a specific product license for the authenticated customer.

product.description: Product name/handle to filter; omit for all.

tools.name: troubleshoot_license
tools.title: Troubleshoot my license activation
tools.description: Diagnose "license not working / expired / not active" for the authenticated customer — combines their real license state with the activation diagnostic guide. Provide the exact NinjaTrader message if possible.

symptom.description: What the customer sees in NinjaTrader (exact log line helps).

tools.name: update_license
tools.title: Update or activate my license
tools.description: Activate or update one of the authenticated customer’s licenses. THIS is the tool for a changed machine ID, a new PC, or any rebind of the SAME license type — it replaces the binding in place, so never reset first. mode="machine" binds NinjaTrader machine ID(s) (legacy, NT < 8.1.7.0). mode="named_user" binds the NT account email (NT 8.1.7.0+). Only use reset_license first when SWITCHING between the two types. Confirm the exact machine ID or email with the customer before writing. Requires the licenses:update scope.

machineId1.description: mode=machine: primary NinjaTrader machine ID (Help → Machine ID).

machineId2.description: mode=machine: second machine ID, only for eligible products.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.title: Sign out of ScalperIntel AI
tools.description: End the authenticated customer’s ScalperIntel AI session on the server: revokes their refresh tokens and immediately invalidates access tokens already issued, so nothing further can act on their account until they sign in again. Use when the customer asks to sign out, log out, disconnect their account, or end their session.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.title: Report an issue to the ScalperIntel team
tools.description: Log a bug or unresolved problem for the ScalperIntel team when you genuinely cannot resolve it for the customer. Use THIS tool instead of ever claiming you will "flag", "escalate", or "notify the team" — this is the only thing that actually records an issue. It returns a reference id to give the customer.

summary.description: Clear description of the problem: the product, what the customer sees, and what was already tried.

tools.name: reset_license
tools.title: Reset my license activation
tools.description: CANCELS the license binding, sets status to pending, and SWITCHES the license to the OTHER activation type: resetting a Machine ID license leaves it Named User, and resetting a Named User license leaves it Machine ID. That switch is the entire purpose — use this ONLY to move a license from one type to the other, then call update_license to bind the new type. DO NOT use it for a changed machine ID, a new PC, or a rebind of the same type — for those call update_license directly, which replaces the binding in place. Resetting when an update would do throws away the customer's current binding for no reason. Destructive: confirm with the customer first. Requires licenses:update.
